verdicts.reason: Both pull the 'Out now.' subline away from the headline and put it next to the button, which breaks the grouping. Both also stack the CTA directly under the product circle, leaving the left half and the bottom empty. In A the 'Try It' button overlaps the bottom of the cream circle and 'Out now.' is jammed against the button. B has the same structure, but the button only just touches the circle and 'Out now.' has a little breathing room, so it is slightly cleaner.
